purpose.summary: Reads an employee input file and produces a formatted printed report listing employee SSN, name, ID, title, type, hire date, pay rate, and status. It also computes and prints summary statistics: total records read, counts and average rates for hourly vs. salaried employees, and counts by employee type (1–10).

notable_features: Multi-level SSN field split into three sub-fields with dash literals for formatted output
OCCURS 10 TIMES array for per-type employee counts
Page numbering and line-count logic for paginated report
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
